template_thumbnail.classes: aspect-[1/1.414] bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:ring-2 hover:ring-black hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer overflow-hidden relative

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle border darkens, slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and shadow-sm on interactive cards.
interactions_and_motion.panel_slide: Tips panel slides in from the right edge of the form panel (Sheet/Drawer component from Shadcn).

icons.usage: Use crisp, minimalist icons with stroke-width 1.5 or 2.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 3-panel layout: Sidebar (Navigation - w-64), Form Workspace (Editor - flex-1), Live Preview (Document - w-[45%]).
Redesign the Entry page: Remove the massive hero section. Replace it with a compact, centered view showing 'Create from Scratch' and 'Upload Resume' as two side-by-side cards.
Insert a 'Template Selection' step immediately after the Entry page. Users must select a template grid before entering the editor.

Fix the Quick Fix cards: They are currently bloated blocks. Convert them to single-line compact strips (max height 40px). Use flex-row, an icon, single-line truncated text, a points badge, and a right-aligned fix action button. Stack them tightly.
Remove inline 'Tips & Fixes' blocks. Instead, add a 'Tips & Fixes' button in the form header that triggers a side panel (e.g., Shadcn Sheet) anchored to the right of the Form Workspace.
Add an 'AI Enhance' button to each editing section (Summary, Experience, Education) - place it top-right of the textarea or section header.
Add a 'Generate Summary AI' feature button specifically inside the Summary form section.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, forms, buttons, and popovers, heavily customized to match the Swiss & High-Contrast style (crisp edges, border-zinc-200, bg-zinc-50, black accents).
